verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਕਰਨਿ ਉਦਾਸੀ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh sukh fal saadhasa(n)g maiaa a(n)dhar karan udhaasee|

en.bdb: Gumukhs get pleasure in the company of saints. They remain indifferent to maya though they live in it.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਕਵਲੁ ਹੈ ਸੂਰਜ ਧ੍ਯਾਨੁ ਅਗਾਸੁ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ।
verses.translit_en: jiau jal a(n)dhar kaval hai sooraj dhayaan agaas nivaasee|

en.bdb: As a lotus, which remains in water and yet keep its gaze fixed towards the sun, gurmukhs always keep their consciousness attuned to the Lord.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚੰਦਨੁ ਸਪੀਂ ਵੇੜਿਆ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸੁਗੰਧਿ ਵਿਗਾਸੀ।
verses.translit_en: cha(n)dhan sapee(n) veRiaa seetal saa(n)t suga(n)dh vigaasee|

en.bdb: The sandalwood remains entwined by snakes but still it spreads cool and peace-producing fragrance all around.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਸਹਜਿ ਬਿਲਾਸੀ।
verses.translit_en: saadhasa(n)gat sa(n)saar vich sabadh surat liv sahaj bilaasee|

en.bdb: Gurmukhs living in the world, through the company of the saints keeping the consciousness attuned to the Word, move around in equipoise.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਭੋਗ ਭੁਗਤਿ ਜਿਣਿ ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਅਛਲ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ।
verses.translit_en: jog jugat bhog bhugat jin jeevan mukat achhal abinaasee|

en.bdb: They conquering the technique of yoga and bhog (enjoyment) become liberated in life, undecievable and indestructible.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪੂਰਣ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਆਸ ਨਿਰਾਸੀ।
verses.translit_en: paarabraham pooran braham gur paramesar aas niraasee|

en.bdb: As the transcendetal Brahm is the perfect Brahm , the same way the Guru who is indifferent to hopes and desires is also nothing but God.
(Through the Guru) that ineffable story and unmenifest light of the Lord becomes known (to the world).
